## UploadedFile interface

Remote write source: the reference returned once bytes have been fully uploaded to the service.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface UploadedFile
```

## Remarks

Usable by an operation until it is consumed or expires. An expired or incomplete upload fails with a transfer error and never reaches the app.
